timeline.author: John Verwolf

timeline.body:
This PR combines `float`, `half_float`, and `scaled_float` into the same field type family. 

Relates to https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/58483

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/67723

timeline.author: John Verwolf

timeline.body: I decided to keep this very simple instead of adding more mechanism/abstraction for Type Families here.  I figure we can decide to add that once we have a few more use cases to generalize from. Happy to change that though based on feedback. WDYT?
